body.statement: If \(h_{x,y}|_{T(S)}\notin\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Q}(B)\), then there exist \(\theta^+,\theta^-\in\Theta_S\) with rational coordinates, \(\theta_j^+(r_j)>0\) and \(\theta_j^-(r_j)>0\) for every \(j\) and every \(r_j\in T_j(S)\), such that \(P_{\theta^+}=P_{\theta^-}\) and \(\tau_{x,y}(\theta^+)\ne\tau_{x,y}(\theta^-)\). The pair may be chosen to differ in exactly one district law.
body.justification: The converse must preserve independence, strict positivity on the active chart, exact support, and exact equality of the observational law.
body.gap: Classical hedges need not preserve a prescribed zero pattern, while polynomial and credal optimization need not emit exact symbolic interior twins.
body.consumer: Every failure certificate becomes a reproducible pair of finite SCMs rather than an optimizer's nonsingleton interval.
